addresses.release_and_reconnect: Exact precreated disposable test queue name; no broker address syntax interpretation

publisher.sender_configuration: rhea open_sender(address) defaults; MIXED proposal negotiated by server to UNSETTLED
publisher.confirmation: Remote Accepted and remote settlement verified before closing

receiver.FIRST_roundtrip: rhea open_receiver(address) defaults, autoaccept enabled, locked rhea default credit window 1000; only one message published
receiver.SECOND_roundtrip: rcv_settle_mode=1, autoaccept=false, credit_window=0, explicit one credit; wait for matching Accepted remote settlement
receiver.release_and_reconnect_both_modes: Manual one-credit control; FIRST and SECOND; SECOND additionally confirms Released/Accepted remote settlement

payload.binary: All byte values 0-255 plus additional 0x00/0xff bytes
payload.storage: SQL verifies exact stored encoded wire bytes before any receiver; accepted consumption eventually clears queue count and message rows

redelivery.release: Release once, receive same message twice, then Accepted
redelivery.reconnect: AMQP Close handshake without acknowledgement, fresh connection and link, redelivery after lease expiry, then Accepted

tls.pki: Disposable test CA and PEM client certificate/key
